# Feature: Session logs, replay and forks

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Make recorded sessions reviewable: a reviewer can find a session in seconds, replay it to pinpoint where something went wrong, and fork a new playable session from any replay point. Built immediately after player-movement so every later feature's playtest evidence is a replayable session, not just screenshots.

## User Story

**As a** reviewer
**I want** to find, replay and fork a recorded session
**So that** I can pinpoint the exact failing move instead of guessing from a still image.

## High-Level Use Case

Reviewer opens the Sessions menu, filters to the session, opens it (or follows a ?replay=<id>&t=<seconds> deep link — time-based per NQ30), watches the replay with speed controls (1x, 2x, 5x, 10x; NQ29: no idle-gap compression so the countdown timer reads exactly), and forks from the paused point to try a different action.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the Sessions menu, when filtering by level, creator, feature, date, result or annotation labels, then the named session is findable in seconds.
- Given a replay, when it plays, then inputs play back at their recorded t_ms spacing (viewer speed 1x/2x/5x/10x, pause/step/scrub) and the per-step readout shows step, position, inventory, orbs left, timer and the input.
- Given a paused replay, when the reviewer forks, then a new playable session starts from that state; its header keeps the original created_by and adds forked_by, forked_from and fork_step.
- Given a session, when a note or label is added afterwards, then it is appended as an annotation line; replay ignores annotations. Labels are free-form lowercase (NQ28), with failed and bug as suggested starters.
- Given a replay under a different level/engine version than recorded, then the UI warns instead of diverging silently.

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Deep links are time-based: ?replay=<session-id>&t=<seconds> lands on that moment (step index is derived from t_ms).
- Annotations are append-only; a correction is a new line.
- Only the game loop is deterministic; level generation happens outside it (NQ26).

## UI / Feedback

- Sessions menu with filters and a replay bar (play/pause, step, scrubber, speed).
- Per-step state readout (step, position, inventory, orbs, timer, input).

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- No new sprites.
- Session JSONL files under sessions/ (gitignored).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A named session is findable in seconds via filters.
- [ ] Notes/labels can be added after play without touching recorded steps.
- [ ] Replay with a t-based deep link lands on the exact moment; record-then-replay reaches the same end state.
- [ ] Fork from a replay point is playable and keeps the original created_by.
- [ ] Version mismatch warns.

## Out of Scope

- Spawning board tasks from a bug-labelled session (linking in a comment is enough for v1).

## Open Questions

- Replay speed set is 1x/2x/5x/10x (NQ29); no idle-gap compression.

## Testing

Needs a mechanics playground: none — verified against recorded sessions of the movement-room Test Level. Verification records its own sessions.
